note: The deal's cast, with three candidate stock voices for each role and the line each sample says. 'voice' is the chosen voice (11/7): the first candidate for each role except the sales engineer, who moved from af_nicole to af_bella since af_nicole sounds breathy. The scored set's people live in their own call specs. Kokoro-82M stock voices only, never a clone.

AE.name: Marcus Webb
AE.sample: Thanks for making the time, Rachel. Before I show you anything, I'd love to hear how you're keeping an eye on temperatures across the fleet today.

SE.name: Priya Natarajan
SE.sample: The gateway rides on cellular, so the dock's Wi-Fi never comes into it, and every reading lands in your history within a minute.

OPS.name: Rachel Torres
OPS.sample: Honestly? A reefer unit died overnight two weeks ago, and nobody knew until load-out. That was fourteen thousand dollars of seafood and dairy.

IT.name: Tom Becker
IT.sample: My first question is what this has to touch. If it needs a hole in the firewall, we're going to have a long conversation.

CFO.name: Linda Marsh
CFO.sample: I've seen the numbers Rachel sent over. What I need to understand is what it costs if we start with a pilot and walk away after thirty days.
